name: POSITIVE NEGATIVE
query:
SELECT
    L.date AS "Date",
    L.patient AS "PID",
    L.patient_name AS "Name",
    L.patient_age AS "Age:Data:50",
    Lt.lab_test_name AS "Test Name:Data:100",
    
    CASE 
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(Lt.result_value)) = 'positive' THEN 'Positive'
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(Lt.result_value)) = 'negative' THEN 'Negative'
        ELSE 'Other'  -- If there's a result that is neither 'positive' nor 'negative'
    END AS "Result",  -- Only one result column
    
    1 AS "Qty"  -- Setting Qty to 1
    
FROM
    `tabLab Result` L
JOIN
    `tabNormal Test Result` Lt ON Lt.parent = L.name
WHERE
    L.date BETWEEN %(From)s AND %(To)s
    AND L.docstatus = 1
    AND (LOWER(TRIM(Lt.result_value)) = 'positive' OR LOWER(TRIM(Lt.result_value)) = 'negative')
    AND Lt.lab_test_name != 'PREGNANT SERUM' 
    AND Lt.lab_test_name != 'PREGNANT URINE'
GROUP BY
    L.date, L.patient, L.patient_name, Lt.lab_test_name, Lt.result_value;
